chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Back in Los Angeles: a new band with Red Callender and Herschel Evans
summary: At 24 he formed a new big band in Los Angeles, adding Red Callender and Herschel Evans, and returned to the Cotton Club.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well it was a very, it was quite a good experience for you. But how old were you when you came back from there?
Well, you'd done a lot hadn't you?
Yes. 24.
So what did you do when you came back?
Well when we came back from China I formed a band again in Los Angeles. came back and Now, I get back, /me and my wife started again. She had been, been back before. I mean, she left before I did.
Yes.
We went back together.
She was in LA was she?
When I got back, yes.
Yes.

She was dancing at different clubs. But I came back and formed a band again, and we got another big band again. We got all the guys together, except the base player, he was still over there. That's when we got Red Callender.
Yes, then we formed a band..........
Oh, you didn't really have Red Callender before?
No.
No, I think you said you did, but this is when you got home?
Right.
Back from Japan.
Now let me think now.
I think you said when you were at the, I believe you said when you were at the Cotton Club.
Yes. You see, we went back to the Cotton Club after, well yes, he was there now. after I came back, I'm sure of it. Yes. Because I also had Herschel Evans, Red Callender in the band when I came back.
You see, Herschel, while we were in China, had come out to California and I liked his playing
so much. I also liked Red Callender.
: Red was a very great bass man. player. A very underrated

Yes. So I worked, again we went in the Cotton Club, but the Cotton Club had kind of faded a little bit. It wasn't exactly the same as it was before we went over. Although it was the same management, it was the same Frank Sebastian.
